title: Bouncing Print Head
brief: A label printer's head moves diagonally: it prints each character of a message one column to the right of the last, stepping down one row at a time until it hits the bottom row, then stepping up one row at a time until it hits the top row, and bouncing like that until the message ends.

The printer then transmits the label row by row, top row first, each row read left to right. Implement rowByRowReadout(s, rowCount), where s is the message and rowCount is the number of rows the head moves across, and return the transmitted string.
